title: Great deal
text: Great deal. No matter how tight it is there is still a slight wobble but it's super cute and a great piece for my living room it holds extra candle wax batteries flash lights etc but the look of it is perfect with a small lamp and flower arrangement you would never guess it's such a low price

product_metadata.title: VASAGLE Bathroom Floor Storage Cabinet, Bathroom Storage Unit with 2 Adjustable Shelves, Bathroom Cabinet Freestanding, 11.8 x 23.6 x 31.5 Inches, Mystic Gray UBCB060P36
features: [Spacious yet Space-Saving] Sized at 11.8"D x 23.6"W x 31.5"H, this bathroom storage unit occupies a small footprint while offering lots of storage. With this unit, you can utilize your bathroom space to the max
[Sturdy, Stable, and Safe] Made of robust MDF, this bathroom storage cabinet is sturdy and stable; the anti-tip kit hidden on the back of this storage cabinet adds to the overall stability and safety
[Adjustable Shelves] This bathroom storage unit comes with 2 adjustable shelves (each has 3 heights) behind the doors, allowing you to organize both tall and short items and keep them away from dust

[Beautiful Addition to Any Room] Mystic gray color, combined with unique beadboard-style cabinet, make a stylish storage unit that fits in easily with your home decor, whether it’s your bathroom, living room, or entryway
[Easy-Peasy Assembly] Never worry about assembly! Numbered parts and easy-to-follow instructions make this freestanding bathroom cabinet a breeze to assemble

details.Included Components: 1 x Bathroom Floor Cabinet, 1 x Accessory Bag, 1 x Anti-Tip Kit, 1 x Instructions
